Definition: adverb from the base of G4226; an interrogative particle of manner; in what way? (sometimes the question is indirect, how?); also as exclamation, how much!:--how, after (by) what manner (means), that. (Occasionally unexpressed in English).
BiblicalUsage: Pos is the word for how, in what way, and it carries a hundred questions through the New Testament. Paul asks how a man builds on the foundation, and John asks how the love of God dwells in a man who shuts his heart to his brother.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that how questions are where faith gets practical, because the gospel is not only what to believe but how to live it.
